source: actual Unity 6000.5.6f1 PlayMode frames at 1206x2622 and 60 fps
visualReasons: The one-frame flash was a large flat oval behind the product and still read as a generic effect plate.
Small bright foil particles crossed the case label and read as confetti instead of authored material release.
The full foil strip and cavity remained visible until the last handoff frame, then disappeared too abruptly.
The case sheen was a broad bright vertical band rather than one restrained material pass.
The moving foil highlight read as a small rectangular sticker instead of a narrow traveling specular line.
corrections: Shrink the flash to the aperture and retain the same dark case silhouette.
Move three foil shards, three glints, and two streaks behind the product.
Move the strip out of frame during Pack retreat and clear cavity/contact layers before handoff end.
Lengthen and narrow the specular geometry.
